Game Rules

Classic 8-Ball Pool Rules & Strategy

8-Ball Pool is a call-shot game played with a cue ball and 15 object balls (numbered 1 to 15). One player assigned to solids (balls 1–7) and the other to stripes (balls 9–15) must clear their group before pocketing the 8-ball to win.

  • Opening Break: The 8-ball is racked in the center of the triangle. The table remains open until a group is established by legally potting a ball after the break.
  • Legal Shots: On every shot, the cue ball must hit a ball from your assigned group first, and at least one ball must hit a cushion or be pocketed.
  • Winning the Game: Pocket the 8-ball into a called pocket after clearing all your group balls. Pocketing the 8-ball early or on a foul results in a loss.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

  • How do 8-ball pool rules work in this game?

    8-ball pool is played with 15 object balls (1-7 solids, 9-15 stripes, and the 8-ball). One player clears solids while the other clears stripes. Pocketing the 8-ball legally after clearing your set wins the frame.

  • Can I play 8-ball pool with friends online for free?

    Yes! Enter the online lobby, select a connected player to send a challenge, or invite a friend to play online for free with no account registration.

  • Is there any software download or installation needed?

    No installation is required. The entire game runs in HTML5 and WebGL inside any desktop or mobile web browser.
